name.description: Column name; must be a bare identifier.

nullable.description: Whether the column may hold nulls.

FreshnessSeverity.description: Severity of the observation-phase staleness report.

oneOf.description: Staleness is reported as a failure.
Staleness is reported as a warning.

FreshnessSpec.description:
Declared freshness: the lag budget plus the column that witnesses it.

`time_column` is required. Without it the observation-phase staleness check (`MAX(time_column)` against the budget) has nothing to read, and freshness would be a claim with no witness.

error_after.description: Age above which the output reports `error`. Must not be shorter than `warn_after`.

max_lag.description: Deprecated: write `warn_after` / `error_after`. Lag budget in the duration grammar (`"24h"`).

severity.description: Deprecated, only with `max_lag`: severity for the staleness report.

time_column.description: The timestamp column the staleness check reads.

warn_after.description: Age above which the output reports `warn` (`"12h"`).

OutputSpec.description: The one output model and the guarantees around it.

checks.description: Opaque SQL boolean expressions, checked by the engine.

classifications.description:
Column classification tags.

Held in an insertion-ordered map because the sidecar merge must be able to preserve an order it is given. The parser fills it in sorted key order: `toml::Value` hands back a sorted map, so document order is not recoverable here without span-based parsing. Sorted is deterministic, which is what byte-stable output needs; recovering true document order belongs with the merge that actually rewrites a human's file.

grain.description: The columns that identify one row.

model.description: Model name; defaults to the product name when omitted.

deliver_by.description: When the output must be delivered: a standard 5-field cron expression, read in `timezone`. Each occurrence is a deadline. Absent means the product declares no deadline, and no lateness is recorded for it.

intent.description: Plain-language statement of what the product is for.

name.description: Product name; names the state directory and the default model.

timezone.description: The IANA timezone `deliver_by` is read in (`"Europe/Lisbon"`). Defaults to UTC when omitted. Valid only beside `deliver_by`.

trust.description: How much the agent is trusted.

SourceSpec.description:
Grounding sources: exact `catalog.schema.table` triples only.

v0 has no globs and no `include` selectors, because no engine counterpart exists. An `include` key is refused as an unknown key; a glob smuggled inside `tables` is refused here.

tables.description: One or more exact table references.

TrustSpec.description: The trust dial. `propose_only` is the only v0 value.

agent.description: How much the agent may do unattended.

description: The whole document: an optional version pin plus `[product]`.
